regions.region: page 1 title, authors, metadata, abstract, and graphical abstract
regions.finding: Verified the article title and the current N-homoallenyl-tryptamine gold-catalyzed [2+2] reaction class. The up-to-93% ee statement is aggregate evidence and the drawing is linked to one general-scheme record, not counted as an extra scope experiment.

regions.region: page 1 Figure 1 and introduction
regions.finding: Figure 1 shows previously reported Tanaka/Nozaki phosphahelicenes and the authors' earlier HelPhos family as ligand/background structures. It contains no present-paper reaction arrow or experiment; cited prior catalytic applications in the prose were not imported as current-paper records.

unresolved: The generic graphical-abstract X/R groups and catalyst structure do not define one complete experiment-specific molecular encoding.
The publisher's Supporting Information link does not establish workspace SI association.

regions.region: page 2 Figure 2 and strategy prose
regions.finding: Figure 2 is design/motivation comparing prior HelPhos-P with current HelPhos-V; it is not a reaction experiment. Prior cyclotrimerization/functionalization literature was not promoted to current-paper runs.

regions.region: page 2 precursor-1 preparation paragraph
regions.finding: Recorded the explicitly reported four-step preparation of 1 as unresolved because bromination, MOM protection, trans-halogenation, and Sonogashira operations are named but all reagents/conditions/yield are delegated to unassociated SI.

regions.region: page 2 Scheme 1 arrows a-e and footnotes
regions.finding: Recorded three independent arrow-level experiments: 1+(R)-2 to 3 (91%, 5.2 g); two-step 3 to 4 (BCl3 deprotection then triflation, 82% overall); and two-step 4+5 to 6 (Suzuki then TBAF deprotection, 79% overall, 3.4 g). Each temperature/time and solvent carrier is paired with its own ordered step.

regions.region: page 2 lower-right Scheme 2 narrative and ligand-screen paragraph
regions.finding: Linked the explicit gram-scale 6 to (M)/(P)-7 cyclotrimerization to the page-3 Scheme 2 record and recorded the alternative-ligand screen as unresolved aggregate evidence; no individual unprinted ligand outcomes were invented.

unresolved: Precursor-1 and ligand-screen experimental details are only in unassociated SI or not row-resolved in main text.
Scheme 1 omits absolute charges, solvent volumes, atmospheres, workups, and individual yields for its two-step sequences.

regions.region: page 3 upper-left Scheme 2 and route-yield prose
regions.finding: Recorded 2.4 g triyne 6, Ni(cod)2 20 mol%, PPh3 40 mol%, THF/room temperature/30 min, 0.91 g (M)-7, 1.03 g (P)-7, 81% combined yield and 47:53 ratio. The separate 48% overall yield from compounds 1 and 2 is retained as a route-level outcome, not a final-step yield.

regions.region: page 3 lower-left Scheme 3 arrows a-c
regions.finding: Recorded three independent transformations: (P)-7 bromination to 8 (72%, unique regioisomer), Suzuki coupling 8 to 9 (81%), and Sonogashira coupling 8 to 10 (90%), including every printed catalyst loading, solvent ratio, temperature, and time.

regions.region: page 3 right Figure 3a and complexation prose
regions.finding: Recorded distinct (M)-7 and (P)-7 two-step oxide-reduction/gold-complexation experiments. The footnote additive (4-NO2-C6H4O)2P(O)OH is a participant; 73%/74:26 and 72%/79:21 outcomes remain mixture-level. Separate partial records preserve isolated 12 and 13 without propagating unprinted conditions.

regions.region: page 3 X-ray panels/captions
regions.finding: Linked CCDC 1984557/1984558 to (M)/(P)-7 and CCDC 1984559/1984560 to exo-(M)-11/endo-(P)-11 as characterization provenance; no new preparation or SI association was created.

unresolved: Gold-complex preparations 12 and 13 have no printed yields, charges, or operating conditions in pages 1-6.
Most Scheme 2/3 arrows omit absolute charges, solvent volumes, workups, purifications, and yield bases.

regions.region: page 4 upper-left Table 1 reaction header, entries 1-6, catalyst drawings, and footnotes
regions.finding: Recorded all six catalyst rows independently with 14, catalyst/AgPF6 4 mol%, toluene, 20 °C, 20 h, NMR conversions, signed HPLC ee values, and entry-6 isolated yield 92%. Trimethoxybenzene is retained as an explicit measurement participant.

regions.region: page 4 lower/right Scheme 4a
regions.finding: Separated the cited HelPhos-S-AuCl 16 to 17 result from two current comparison experiments using endo-(P)-11 and endo-(P)-12; catalyst-specific yields/ee remain in separate records.

regions.region: page 4 Scheme 4b-c
regions.finding: Classified the tandem propargylic-ester rearrangement/[2+2] as cited prior methodology and merged Scheme 4c with the page-1 current generic homoallenyl-tryptamine reaction class. No generic arrow was counted as a scope experiment.

regions.region: page 4 optimization prose below Table 1
regions.finding: The additional silver-salt/solvent/0 °C screens are only summarized as not improving the result and referred to SI. No row-specific conditions or outcomes were fabricated.

unresolved: The post-entry-4 AgX/solvent/0 °C screen lacks row-resolved main-text outcomes and remains unextracted from unassociated SI.
Scheme 4a omits time and most operational/analytical details; Scheme 4b is generic prior literature.

regions.region: page 5 upper-left Scheme 5 header, products 19a-e, footnotes a-b, and X-ray panel
regions.finding: Recorded seven distinct current scope experiments: two catalysts for 19a, one for 19b, two for 19c, one for 19d, and one for 19e. Shared AuCl/AgNTf2 5 mol%, toluene, room temperature, 24 h, product yields and ee are applied row-wise; CCDC 1984561 is linked to 19a characterization.

regions.region: page 5 left-column scope prose
regions.finding: Merged prose-isolated 19a yields/ee and catalyst choices with the matching Scheme 5 rows. AgNTf2-screen details outside the displayed successful conditions were not inferred from SI.

regions.region: page 5 upper-right Scheme 6 and mechanism prose
regions.finding: Classified allene activation, 6-exo indole addition/dearomatization, vinyl-gold ring closure, and catalyst release as one proposed mechanism. Intermediates I/II are not isolated experiments.

regions.region: page 5 conclusion, Associated Content, and author information
regions.finding: The conclusion restates the up-to-93% ee result. The publisher lists online SI, but workspace association remains unestablished; no SI procedure, HPLC, NMR, or crystallographic detail was imported.

unresolved: Scheme 5 omits absolute charges, solvent volume, atmosphere, workup, purification, isolated masses, and ee analytical basis.
Online SI availability does not establish an associated workspace SI file.

regions.finding: Administrative and abbreviation material only. It introduces no current-paper reaction arrow, procedure, reagent dose, condition, outcome, failure, or characterization mapping.

regions.region: page 6 references 1-6 in both columns
